name: Grandstream GWN7001 Multi-WAN Gigabit VPN Router
description: Wired multi-WAN VPN router with 6 Gigabit ports (all WAN/LAN configurable), 2.2 Gbps NAT routing, 530 Mbps IPsec VPN, up to 50 VPN tunnels and 30K NAT sessions. Built-in firewall (no published firewall throughput). Embedded controller manages the router and up to 100 GWN APs.

name: Grandstream GWN7002 Multi-WAN Gigabit VPN Router
description: Wired multi-WAN VPN router with 4 Gigabit ports and 2 x 2.5G SFP ports (all WAN/LAN configurable), 2 PoE-out ports (48V passive or 802.3af), PoE-in, 2.2 Gbps NAT routing, 530 Mbps IPsec VPN, up to 50 VPN tunnels and 30K NAT sessions. Built-in firewall (no published firewall throughput). Embedded controller manages the router and up to 100 GWN APs.

name: Grandstream GWN7003 Multi-WAN Gigabit VPN Router
description: Rack-mountable wired multi-WAN VPN router with 9 Gigabit ports and 2 x 2.5G SFP ports (all WAN/LAN configurable), 2 PoE-out ports (48V passive or 802.3af), PoE-in, 2.2 Gbps NAT routing, 530 Mbps IPsec VPN, up to 100 VPN tunnels and 60K NAT sessions. Built-in firewall (no published firewall throughput). Embedded controller manages the router and up to 150 GWN APs.

name: Grandstream GCC6010 UC + Networking Convergence Gateway
description: All-in-one VPN router, next-generation firewall (anti-virus, L3-L7 IDS/IPS, DPI, SSL inspection), IP PBX and PoE switch. 2 x 2.5G SFP and 5 x Gigabit ports (all WAN/LAN configurable, max 3 WAN), 4 PoE-out ports (802.3af/at, 36 W), 2.5 Gbps routing, 1 Gbps IPsec VPN, 900 Mbps IDS/IPS, 160K NAT sessions. Embedded controller manages up to 150 GWN APs and 500 clients. Desktop or wall mount.

name: Grandstream GCC6011 UC + Networking Convergence Gateway
description: Rack-mountable all-in-one VPN router, next-generation firewall (anti-virus, L3-L7 IDS/IPS, DPI, SSL inspection), IP PBX and PoE switch. 2 x 2.5G SFP and 10 x Gigabit ports (3 fixed WAN), 4 PoE-out ports (802.3af/at, 36 W), 2.5 Gbps routing, 1 Gbps IPsec VPN, 900 Mbps IDS/IPS, 160K NAT sessions, optional M.2 SSD. Embedded controller manages up to 150 GWN APs and 500 clients.

name: Grandstream GCC6020 UC + Networking Convergence Gateway
description: All-in-one VPN router, next-generation firewall (anti-virus, L3-L7 IDS/IPS, DPI, SSL inspection), IP PBX and PoE switch. 1 x 10G SFP+, 1 x 2.5GbE and 4 x Gigabit ports (all WAN/LAN configurable, max 3 WAN), 5 PoE-out ports (802.3af/at, 120 W), 6.5 Gbps routing, 1.3 Gbps IPsec VPN, 6 Gbps NGFW (DPI+IPS), 320K NAT sessions. Embedded controller manages up to 300 GWN APs and 500 clients. Desktop, wall or rack mount.

name: Grandstream GCC6021 UC + Networking Convergence Gateway
description: Rack-mountable all-in-one VPN router, next-generation firewall (anti-virus, L3-L7 IDS/IPS, DPI, SSL inspection), IP PBX and PoE switch. 4 x 10G SFP+ (port 28 fixed WAN), 8 x 2.5GbE and 16 x Gigabit ports (max 5 WAN), 24 PoE-out ports (8 x 802.3af/at/bt, 16 x 802.3af/at, 370 W), 2 HA ports, 10 Gbps routing, 1.3 Gbps IPsec VPN, 9 Gbps NGFW (DPI+IPS), 320K NAT sessions. Embedded controller manages up to 300 GWN APs and 1,000 clients.
